notes.title: Dispel the confusion: The tutorial has been added to the game!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]It's time for an update again. This update took much longer than I expected, but the content is crucial. Let's see what's new![/p][p]Most importantly, we have added a beginner tutorial. The most important content of the game will pop up when needed. If you don't want any interruptions, you can also choose to skip all tutorials. You can also actively click the book button on the interface to watch the tutorial.[/p][p]Then there is the fix for a bug where the game might crash when the mouse passes over relics with broken marks. Stopped the boss's crazy behavior of equipping itself with 5 layers of \[Firmness] upon appearing, which is actually a logical error.[/p][p]The boss's action patterns have also been modified, making their behavior more diverse.[/p][p]The amount of gold obtained from lower rank challenges has been increased.[/p][p]Finally, updates to make the game more interesting: some relics' effects have been adjusted, and some new relics have replaced the old ones. The adjusted game will be more flexible, with a closer connection between different construction systems.[/p]

notes.title: New mechanism is coming!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Nearly 10 days have passed since the last update. I have updated some content quietly, but I am too busy to update the description.[/p][p]So, what have I been up to?[/p][p]The answer is this huge update![/p][p]This update introduces three completely new mechanics, some new relics, and a number of relic adjustments. The way attacks are judged has changed. The logic and numerical values of the enemy's behavior have also changed dramatically. Let's take a look at these exciting changes.[/p][p]1 New mechanism-THROWING. Some attack items will have \[throwing] in the description. This is a bit complicated, but players should understand it quickly after using it in the game.[/p][p]In the previous version,if \[max_attack_count] of a relic was enough,it will directly clear the enemy's \[substitute] and make a addition attack. In the current version, each enemy can only be attacked once per attack. Throwing attacks can make full use of \[max_attack_count] in bounce after bounce, and consume \[substitute] first. Therefore, when building up relics, a single relic with high damage value and high attack count (such as \[blue_crystal]) can no longer run rampant in the world. It needs to be used together with throwing relics to effectively stop the enemy waves.[/p][p]2 New mechanism-VERTIGO , when the enemy's block become 0, if it has \[substitute], it gains \[substitute] equal \[vertigo],\[vertigo] immediately cancels all \[action] of the enemy and slowly moves to the front of the chariot queue. \[vertigo] has won valuable respite for players. Please make full use of it.[/p][p]3 New mechanism-RUIN. Some relics now have the \[ruin] attribute. When ruined, relics lose their effect and their name gains the \[broken] field. This is paired with a brand new REPAIRMAN series relic.[/p][p]4 \[substitute] of enemies of late stage is greatly reduced, while HP and \[block] are greatly increased[/p][p]There are also many changes, please explore the game, I hope you can fully enjoy this update![/p][p]About the next update: Many players have reported that they need some beginner tutorials. This will be the main work next. I believe it will meet you soon.[/p]

notes.title: A new relic is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Since the demo of the "Ender Chariot" was launched, it has quietly undergone multiple updates, fixing many serious bugs that directly prevent the game from working. It has also added some new relics and made many adjustments to the functionality. So the question arises - how to let players know that the annoying bugs are gone, and how to let players know what the interesting new features are.
Then I suddenly remembered that Steam actually has an announcement feature.

The focus of this update is on the [Bloody] series of relics. This batch of relics belongs to the original batch designed, simple and powerful, except for the advanced relic [Bloody Egg With Holes] in this series. Due to the [Sin Mark], the conditions for the appearance of [Bloody Egg With Holes] are difficult to meet, and its benefits are not as good as other later relics, so this has laid a hidden danger. With the development of the game, the new framework has caused the [Bloody Egg With Holes] to fail to function properly. And during the later testing, I hardly used it, so the problem was left over until now. At the same time, [Ring Of Thorns], which has a similar problem, was also found to be problematic.

[Ring Of Thorns] has been simply removed from the current game version, but there is no need to feel sorry about it, as it has not left us, it has just gone to a slightly distant place. Er... what I mean is, it has been transferred to the relic pool of the [Priest] role, where it will excel. In return, the [Bloody] has added a powerful intermediate relic [Bloody Hand], as shown in the following figure
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612774/ff833c498f2736bd23c91d075ecd2028e6fc6d65.png[/img]
It can directly change the history where the [Bloody] series could only be a complement, strongly removing the [Sin Mark] while being able to support [Dragon Meat] above and match with [Bloody Egg With Holes] below, all of which are tools for obtaining the [Immortal]. As for the negative effect of gaining [Hesitate] with a number of [Relic Value] at the start of each battle, it looks really terrifying, but players who are familiar with the game must have been drooling already. I can think of two combos in an instant. Can you guess who they are?
Additionally, the [Bloody Egg With Holes] has the ability to clear all negative effects. It's finally not a burden anymore...
